questions.prompt: Which is the safest default for practising combining commands with pipes?

questions.explanation: For Combining Commands with Pipes, use a controlled lab, change one factor at a time, and record the exact result. Some operations in this area can affect data, availability, or access if performed on a real system.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach after a change or observation related to combining commands with pipes?
options: Treat a missing command as proof that Linux is not installed.
Hide the error output and record only the final screen.
Reproduce the observation, test one boundary or failure case, compare expected and actual results, and document the relevant version or distribution.

questions.answer_key: Reproduce the observation, test one boundary or failure case, compare expected and actual results, and document the relevant version or distribution.
